title: Umami Peruvian Sweet Potato Picarones
description: Pillowy Peruvian picarones filled with umami flavor, perfect for a brunch mood, made with sweet potatoes and beurre-monte, in a plant-based friendly form
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potatoes, flour, bicarbonate of soda, and salt.
Add the beurre-monte, umami seasoning, and water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fry in the hot oil for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the picarones on paper towels and serve warm.
Sprinkle with additional umami seasoning if desired.
Serve the picarones with your favorite dipping sauce.
